info.title: Payroll Management API
info.description: REST API for the NexziByte Payroll Management application. All endpoints except /auth/login, /health and /ready require the session cookie; permissions are enforced on every request.

Sign out and revoke the current session

post.summary: Change own password (revokes other sessions)

get.summary: List users

Set a temporary password, unlock the account and revoke sessions
Clear a sign-in lockout

get.summary: List roles with permissions
Permission catalogue

put.summary: Replace a role's permissions (applies the client's confirmed permission matrix)

List departments

get.summary: List designations

post.summary: Create a designation
